changelog: Added Data Import & Export to easily back up and restore your watch history, watchlist, and settings.
Introduced Media Share Modal with QR code support and deep linking.
Redesigned Media Details Page with an improved layout, action buttons, and related content tabs.
Enhanced Discord Rich Presence with customizable display modes (Detailed or Minimal).
Added an Episode Chunk Selector to easily navigate long TV series seasons.
Boosted overall app performance and deletion operations speed.

features.title: What's New
items: Data Backup & Restore: Export your watch history, favorites, and settings to a JSON file and restore them anytime.
Share via QR Code & Direct Links: Easily share movies and series with friends using QR codes or smart deep links that open directly in the app.
Full Media Details Redesign: Enjoy a completely revamped movie and series details page featuring improved media overviews, quicker action buttons, and better posters.
Related Content & Collections: Discover more content directly from the media details page with brand-new tabs for Recommendations, Similar Titles, and Movie Collections.
Episode Chunk Navigation: Browse long seasons effortlessly using the new episode chunk selector.
Discord Rich Presence Modes: Customize how your watch status appears on Discord by choosing between Detailed or Minimal display mode.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Faster Deletion Operations: Optimized app performance and responsiveness when deleting or clearing items.
Enhanced Server Selector for smoother streaming source navigation.
Upgraded Settings layout and animation quality controls.
Fun celebration animations when clearing or deleting items.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: General visual fixes, smoother transitions, and layout adjustments for smaller screens.
